description: This source file is a shell script designed to run a suite of HTTP status tests for the gitweb standalone CGI script. It sets environment variables, sources external library scripts, performs prechecks for Perl modules, configures settings for snapshots, tests various HTTP responses for different repository objects, handles modification time conditions, checks load, and validates argument error handling.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisites for the environment, such as required Perl modules for date parsing.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Executes the gitweb CGI script with specified parameters and captures output.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines test cases that are expected to succeed, specifying setup commands and expected output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after test completion.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Waits for a short period, ensuring changes are registered in the object store.
